entities.summary: Têtu is the main LGBTQIA magazine published in France. It was subtitled in French le magazine des gays et lesbiennes until 2007, and reaffirmed itself as a men's magazine since then. As of December, 2012, its certified circulation was of 41,961 copies monthly. Publication stopped in 2015 until the magazine was reborn and issued its next issue on 28 February 2017.
